subject: wedding DJs
one_liner: The all-in-one workspace for wedding DJs, where every banned song is a database row and the Cha Cha Slide has its own page.
brand_voice_notes: Productivity-tool calm applied to a Saturday night in a hotel ballroom. Talks about the do-not-play list the way enterprise software talks about compliance. Never jokes about the couple. The uncle is a recurring operational risk, referred to only as 'the uncle'. Cuebook is quietly proud of its database properties and has no idea why DJs keep playing Mr. Brightside anyway.

hero.sub: Cuebook turns the couple's do-not-play list, the run of show and 41 napkin requests into linked pages with properties. You will still play Mr. Brightside. Now there is a record of it.

features.title: The Do-Not-Play Database
features.blurb: Each banned song gets 14 properties, a relation to the guest who requested it anyway, and a rollup of how many times you played it regardless. Last season's median was 3.

features.title: Linked Timeline Blocks
features.blurb: Grand entrance, first dance, cake, sparkler exit. Move the cake and the sparklers move with it. The Cha Cha Slide is locked at 9:40 PM and nobody, including our engineers, can unlock it.

features.title: Request Inbox with AI Summaries
features.blurb: Requests shouted over the subwoofer are transcribed, deduplicated and summarized in one line. Most summaries read "Mr. Brightside (again)." The model is correct about this.

pricing_tiers.name: Open Bar
pricing_tiers.tagline: For crews running three receptions on a Saturday.
perks: A human who stands next to the uncle
Support until the 1 AM venue curfew

testimonials.quote: I used to keep the do-not-play list on the back of a Costco receipt. Now it has 14 properties and I still end on Shout. The difference is I can filter it.
testimonials.name: Darnell Okafor
testimonials.title: Owner-Operator, DJ Darnell Events (Mobile Division), Akron

testimonials.quote: The groom's cousin requested Sandstorm eleven times. Cuebook merged them into one row with a counter. Seeing the number helped me.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman
testimonials.title: Lead DJ and Notary Public, Silver Bell Entertainment

testimonials.quote: We moved the whole crew over in a weekend. The bride's mother has comment access now and leaves about 30 per event. All of them say "louder?"
testimonials.name: Gary Lundqvist
testimonials.title: Head of Sound and Uplighting, Lundqvist Bros. Mobile Disco LLC

demo_screen_concept: The Cuebook workspace for the Hart & Moreno reception (Sat, Nov 7, Larkspur Barn). A left sidebar of pages (Run of Show, Requests & Bans, Vendor Contacts, Uncle Protocol). The main pane is the 'Requests & Bans' database with Table / Board / Run of Show view tabs, status filter chips (Queued, Banned, Played anyway, Mom override), live search, a request-count property that increments, and a '+ New request' row. Clicking a row opens a side peek with properties, the guest who asked, and a comment thread. An 'AI summary' button collapses the request inbox into one line. The Run of Show view has a Cha Cha Slide block with a lock toggle that refuses to unlock.

images.rationale: Hero attempted as an editorial photo of a DJ at an empty barn reception; attempt 1 printed a garbled brand name on the controller, attempt 2 put an Apple logo on the laptop, so the hero was dropped and falls back to the typographic invitation card. Demo skipped because the database/document screen is not photo-shaped. Three testimonial headshots generated, all passed on attempt 1.

design_direction.style: Letterpress wedding-stationery editorial, ivory card-stock daylight mode. A workspace SaaS printed like an invitation suite: deckled cards, blind-deboss shadows, gold-foil hairlines, RSVP-card pricing, Notion-style blocks set as stationery inserts.

design_direction.archetype: Minimal single-column SaaS landing composed as an invitation suite: centered hero card, three feature inserts, RSVP-card pricing, testimonial place cards.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Slow, paper-like. Cards lift 2px on hover with a deboss shadow, gold hairlines draw in once on load, nothing bounces. Reduced motion disables all of it.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Centered invitation-card hero: script kicker ('together with their DJ'), large Cormorant headline, sub in body sans, plum CTA. Beside or below it the editorial hero photograph framed like a mounted print with a gold hairline mat.
